title: Chapter 1 Test
instructions: Answer all questions. For fill-in-the-blank and short-answer, use one word, letter, or number only.

questions.prompt: The point where the $ x $-axis and $ y $-axis intersect is called the ___.
In which quadrant does the point $ (-4, 7) $ lie? (I, II, III, or IV)
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Quadrant II has negative $ x $ and positive $ y $.

questions.prompt: The distance between $ (3, 5) $ and $ (0, 1) $ is:
Find the midpoint of the segment joining $ (2, -3) $ and $ (4, 5) $. Give the $ x $-coordinate only.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The $ x $-coordinate of the midpoint is 3.

questions.prompt: To verify that three points form a right triangle, use the ___ Theorem.
Which point lies on the graph of $ y = 3x - 5 $?
Find the $ y $-intercept of the graph of $ 4x - 2y = 8 $. (Give the $ y $-coordinate only.)
The graph of $ x - y^2 = 1 $ is symmetric with respect to the ___-axis.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is symmetric about the x-axis.

questions.prompt: The standard form of a circle with center $ (3, -2) $ and radius 4 is:
What is the radius of the circle $ x^2 + (y+4)^2 = 25 $? (Number only)
The slope of a horizontal line is ___.
Find the slope of the line through $ (1, -1) $ and $ (4, 5) $. (Number only)
Which equation represents a line with slope $ -3 $ and $ y $-intercept $ (0, 2) $?
If $ f(x) = 2x^2 - x $, evaluate $ f(-1) $. (Number only)
The set of all possible input values of a function is its ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The domain is the set of all possible inputs.

questions.prompt: Which graph represents a function? (Use the Vertical Line Test concept.)
options: A line that is not vertical
A graph that intersects a vertical line twice
questions.feedbackIfWrong: A non-vertical line passes the Vertical Line Test and is a function.

questions.prompt: Find the zeros of $ f(x) = x^2 - 16 $. (List numbers separated by comma; smallest first.)
On the interval $ (0, 2) $, the function $ f(x) = |x-1| $ is ___ (increasing or decreasing).
The graph of $ y = x^4 $ is symmetric about which axis? (x or y)
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is symmetric about the y-axis.

questions.prompt: Which parent function has a range of $ [0, \infty) $ and is even?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ f(x)=x^2 $ has range $ [0,\infty) $ and is even.

questions.prompt: What is the value of the greatest integer function $ \lfloor 3.7 \rfloor $? (Number only)
To reflect the graph of $ f(x) $ in the $ x $-axis, use the function $ g(x) = $ ___.
The graph of $ y = (x+3)^2 $ is the graph of $ y = x^2 $ shifted in which direction? (left or right)
Which transformation describes the change from $ f(x)=\sqrt{x} $ to $ g(x)=3\sqrt{x} $?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is a vertical stretch by a factor of 3.

questions.prompt: Given $ f(x)=x+2 $ and $ g(x)=x^2 $, find $ (f+g)(2) $. (Number only)
The quotient $ (f/g)(x) $ is undefined when $ g(x) = $ ___.
$ (f \circ g)(x) $ means:
Given $ f(x)=2x $ and $ g(x)=x+3 $, find $ (f \circ g)(1) $. (Number only)
To decompose $ h(x) = \sqrt{5x+2} $, one possible inner function is $ g(x) = 5x+2 $; the outer function is $ f(x) = $ ___ (name the function).
If $ f $ is one-to-one and $ f(2) = 7 $, what is $ f^{-1}(7) $? (Number only)
The graph of $ f^{-1} $ is the reflection of $ f $ across the line:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is reflected across the line $ y=x $.

questions.prompt: Find the inverse of $ f(x) = x + 9 $. (We will evaluate: find $ f^{-1}(15) $). (Number only)
A function is one-to-one if it passes the ___ Line Test.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It must pass the Horizontal Line Test.

questions.prompt: If $ y $ varies directly as $ x $, and $ y=36 $ when $ x=9 $, find the constant of proportionality $ k $. (Number only)
Which equation represents inverse variation?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Inverse variation has form $ y = k/x $.

questions.prompt: The correlation coefficient $ r $ between two variables is $ -0.88 $. Is the slope of the regression line positive or negative?
The least squares regression line minimizes the sum of the ___ differences between actual and predicted values.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It minimizes the sum of squared differences.

questions.prompt: If $ y $ varies jointly as $ x $ and $ z $, and $ y = 60 $ when $ x = 3 $ and $ z = 4 $, find $ y $ when $ x = 2 $ and $ z = 5 $. (Number only)
The graph of any direct variation $ y = kx $ must:
options: Have a $ y $-intercept that is not zero
questions.feedbackIfWrong: Direct variation graphs always pass through the origin.

questions.prompt: The function $ f(x) = \frac{1}{(x+3)^2} $ can be decomposed as $ f = g \circ h $ with $ h(x) = x+3 $ and $ g(x) = \frac{1}{x^2} $. What is $ (g \circ h)(2) $? (Number only, as a fraction or decimal)
